meaning:
§ Dinhabah = "give thou judgement"
capital city of Bela, king of Edom

elsewhere.note: Bela, the son of Beor, reigned in Edom. The name of his city was Dinhabah.
Now these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel: Bela the son of Beor; and the name of his city…
